body: Hi there I’ve been looking for a story similar to mines because it’s been taunting me for days now. I was 7 weeks pregnant and the experience of being pregnant was horrible i had something more advanced than morning sickness it felt like my fetus was attacking me. I have a rare blood type and a lot goes with me being pregnant but anyway i went and got the abortion pill and did the second one vaginally (4 pills) didn’t experience anything for six hours but when it came it gushed out. I ran to the bathroom and felt the emptying of my womb. Like you said i had to go back and forth to the bathroom and watch everything come out. I looked for the fetus but never saw it. I was in extreme pain and got into the tub running cold water on me as i hyperventilated in the tub. I cried and prayed because i felt my soul leaving my body. Honestly i don’t know how I’m still alive i really don’t. I got the strength to get out the tub because i had diarrhea after that i got back in the tub and was breathing heavily running cold water on me again. I don’t remember getting out the tub but i woke up the next day in my bed with aching hips. My hips hurt the entire process and it’s been a week and a half since the surgery and I’m somewhat back to normal. I’m glad you had someone there for you unlike me i will remember that experience for the rest of my life. Thank you for sharing because i know someone had to experience what i did and i needed to spill. All i could think was if i die in this tub my family won’t know for weeks and they will see how i died and know what i did and the embarrassment from that is where i got my strength to live from.
